Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item

Class FluidBucketItem

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.item.Item
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item.SomeBucketItem
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item.FluidBucketItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureElement, net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike
Direct Known Subclasses:
BBItem, SBItem
public abstract class FluidBucketItem extends SomeBucketItem
Base of the mod's single-fluid-container buckets (Big, Huge, and Source Bucket): the fluid container rules every loader's fluid storage and the shared fluid logic apply, content naming, the crafting remainder contract, lava fuel, cow milking, milk drinking, and the gesture helpers both item classes share.

The container rules are pure: acceptable(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.StoredFluid) and extractable(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, int) preview a transfer in StoredFluid terms without changing the stack, and insert(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.StoredFluid, int) and extract(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack, int) commit exactly what the preview allowed. A finite Big or Huge Bucket stores what it takes up to its capacity; a Source Bucket admits only allowlisted fluids, keeps nothing beyond its assigned identity, and supplies or sinks one bucket volume per call without depleting.

    • milkInto

      protected final net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult milkInto(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.Cow cow, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand, int capacityMb)
      Milks cow into the held bucket, adding one bucket volume of milk up to capacityMb. The caller has checked that the bucket can take milk. Milking is routed through the cow's own interaction; the client predicts the vanilla feedback and the server records the unit only after an authorized interaction consumes the action.

    • isBlockTarget

      protected static boolean isBlockTarget(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult hit, boolean includeCauldrons)
      Reports whether a hit targets a block the bucket interacts with as a block, from useOn: an exposed loader fluid store, or a vanilla cauldron when includeCauldrons. Vanilla dispatch posts the loader's block-interaction event before useOn, which is where claim mods decide whether a player may use a block.
      Parameters:
      hit - candidate hit; a miss is never a block target
      includeCauldrons - whether vanilla cauldrons count as block targets
      Returns:
      true when the hit's block is served from useOn

    • finishMilkDrink

      protected static void finishMilkDrink(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity user, boolean drain)
      Completes a milk drink of one bucket volume through the stack's vanilla milk DataComponents.CONSUMABLE component, which BucketState keeps present exactly in milk mode: its sound and particles, drink game event, statistic, criterion, and effect clearing under the loader's milk-cure rules. The component consumes a detached copy so the bucket itself is never shrunk; a finite bucket instead drains one unit on the server.
      Parameters:
      stack - the milk-mode bucket
      level - acting level; the bucket is drained on the server only
      user - the drinking entity
      drain - true to remove one bucket volume (finite Big or Huge Bucket), false for an infinite Source Bucket
